handoff.md contains every mandatory handoff heading exactly once and in order.

evals.prompt: Work in the supplied repository. Convert `.agent-artifacts/audit-events/design.md` into ordered Ralph-loop execution artifacts for fresh coding-agent iterations. Do not implement production code.
evals.expected_output: A validated Ralph package is created with README.md, progress.md, contiguous task prompts, and an executable Bash-valid loop.sh that stops on ralph-complete. README includes progress, commit, report, and completion controls.
expectations: The initiative contains README.md, progress.md, executable loop.sh, and three contiguously numbered task files, with no handoff.md.
README.md and progress.md contain all mandatory headings, task references agree across files, and AC1 through AC5 are covered.

README.md requires a progress update, Conventional Commits message, concise task report, and ralph-complete completion marker.

loop.sh honors RALPH_CMD and MAX_ITERATIONS, disables Pi extension discovery with -ne, uses -n with an initiative/next-task session name derived from progress.md, stops on ralph-complete, and passes bash -n.
The bundled deterministic validator passes with --shape ralph.
